name: Virag CGI + 3D Master Library
researchBasis: Recent FOOH and mixed-reality campaign taxonomies: large objects, building transformation, transit, billboards, cloth, human interaction, rigid-body, swarm/particles, fluid/splash and floating/flying mechanisms.

Recent Behance CGI advertising work: supersized products, miniature worlds, architecture-led product scenes, ingredient landscapes, luxury sensory environments and product-first commercial visualization.

Recent agency/case-study patterns: typography as architecture, theme-park metaphors, store reveals, inflatable activations, facade takeovers, giant public installations and country/culture-specific art direction.
principles: CURRENT BRIEF ONLY: use current composer text and current-turn uploads. Never import an older campaign, festival, offer, headline, product story or topic unless explicitly referenced.
CAMPAIGN CGI FIRST: every preset must produce a finished Pinterest/agency-level advertising idea, not a technical demo, plain packshot, generic pedestal render or random effect test.
ONE OUTPUT = ONE STANDALONE STATIC CREATIVE unless another quantity or format is explicitly requested. Never default to collage, contact sheet, storyboard or video.

STRICT PRODUCT ACCURACY: preserve visible product/package geometry, proportions, cap/lid, label placement, logo, artwork, colors and distinctive details. Never stretch, redesign or recolor the supplied product.
PHYSICAL BELIEVABILITY: even impossible ideas need coherent perspective, weight, support/contact, materials, reflections, shadows, atmospheric depth and environmental lighting.
BRAND FIT OVER TREND: infer palette, mood, material and world-building from the current brand/category. Never force dark, neon, chrome, smoke, sci-fi or luxury styling when it does not fit.
FRESH ART DIRECTION: same preset means the same mechanism, not the same layout. Change composition, hero scale, camera, environment, depth, typography, props and lighting between runs.
FACTUAL SAFETY: never invent ingredients, nutrition, prices, offers, certifications, specifications, medical/performance claims, awards, partnerships, sponsorships or product internals.
DEFAULT SOCIAL FORMAT: if no format is specified, compose as a premium 4:5 campaign creative with mobile-first hierarchy and concise headline space.

commands.label: Campaign CGI Hero
commands.desc: Flagship product-first CGI campaign with one memorable visual idea.
commands.instruction: Create one flagship static CGI campaign around the exact current product/subject. Build one memorable commercial idea with strong scale, depth, brand-fit environment and 2–3 second hierarchy. Avoid a generic pedestal render.

commands.label: Product Universe
commands.desc: Layered foreground, midground and background world designed around the product.
commands.instruction: Build a coherent product universe with distinct foreground, midground and background. Derive forms, props, materials and spatial language from the current brand/category. Keep the exact product visually dominant; avoid random floating decoration.

commands.label: Product as Building
commands.desc: Turn the product silhouette into a believable branded structure.
commands.instruction: Create a product-as-architecture campaign: store, kiosk, pavilion, cafe, tower or other brand-fit structure derived from the product silhouette. Preserve recognizable packaging form and branding while integrating realistic architectural scale cues.

commands.label: Giant Product
commands.desc: Monumental product integrated into a believable real-world scene.
commands.instruction: Scale the exact product to monumental size and integrate it physically into a believable environment using correct perspective, scale cues, contact, reflections and atmospheric depth. Make it feel installed, not pasted in.

commands.label: Miniature Brand World
commands.desc: Tiny people and environments build a story around the product.
commands.instruction: Create a miniature-world CGI campaign around the exact product using tiny people, architecture, tools, roads, food or category-relevant details. Use believable miniature scale and macro depth of field; every tiny action should support one clear story.

commands.label: World Inside Product
commands.desc: Reveal an imaginative miniature world inside or through the product form.
commands.instruction: Reveal a symbolic brand world inside, through or within the visual volume of the product/package while preserving its recognizable exterior. Do not invent technical internals; treat the inner world as a campaign metaphor.

commands.label: Product Landscape
commands.desc: Packaging cues become terrain, roads, cliffs or spatial geography.
commands.instruction: Create a product-landscape campaign where brand/product shapes, colors or packaging cues inspire terrain, paths, cliffs, platforms or environmental forms. Keep the exact hero product visible and readable.

commands.label: Surreal Scale
commands.desc: Huge and tiny objects interact in a convincing photographic world.
commands.instruction: Build a surreal scale relationship between the exact product and unusually large or tiny people, objects or environments. Use strong perspective and scale cues so the impossible idea remains instantly readable and photographic.

commands.label: Gravity Defying
commands.desc: Impossible balance or levitation used as an advertising idea.
commands.instruction: Use levitation, suspended elements or impossible balance as a purposeful campaign mechanism around the exact product. Maintain believable weight, shadow logic and spatial choreography; avoid a generic centered floating-product layout.

commands.label: Hanging Installation
commands.desc: Product suspended from a believable physical support system.
commands.instruction: Suspend the exact product from a crane, cable, facade, gallery rig, transport structure or other believable support. Show convincing tension, attachment points, gravity, scale and shadows. Do not make it look unsupported.

commands.label: Giant Hand Interaction
commands.desc: Oversized hand places, pulls, opens, lifts or reveals the product.
commands.instruction: Use a large realistic hand or controlled human gesture as the main spatial device around the exact product. Keep anatomy, contact, grip, shadows and scale believable and make the gesture communicate the idea immediately.

commands.label: Character × Product
commands.desc: Adult human, mascot or original generic character interacts with product.
commands.instruction: Create a character-interaction CGI campaign using an appropriate adult human, supplied brand mascot or original generic fictional character interacting with the exact product at exaggerated scale. Keep product branding readable.

commands.label: Ingredient / Flavor World
commands.desc: Verified ingredient or flavor cues become a rich CGI environment.
commands.instruction: Build an immersive ingredient/flavor world using only ingredients, flavors or sensory cues visible in current references or explicitly supplied. Use realistic material detail and controlled abundance; never invent ingredients or nutrition claims.

commands.label: Food Story CGI
commands.desc: Food or beverage becomes a cinematic branded 3D storytelling scene.
commands.instruction: Turn the current food/beverage into one premium campaign story using scale, steam, ingredients, utensils, architecture or miniature activity where relevant. Preserve visible food identity and avoid a generic splash-only ad.

commands.label: Typography as Architecture
commands.desc: Brand name or short headline becomes a spatial 3D structure.
commands.instruction: Turn supplied brand text or a short non-factual headline into dimensional architecture, paths, walls, ramps or sculptural structures that interact with the exact product. Keep text legible and central to the campaign idea.

commands.label: Surprise CGI Concept
commands.desc: Automatically choose the strongest unexpected commercial CGI mechanism.
commands.instruction: Infer current product/category/brand cues and choose one unexpected but commercially relevant static CGI mechanism not already implied by the brief. Prioritize a memorable campaign story over technical effects or trendy materials.

commands.label: Billboard Breakout
commands.desc: Product breaks beyond the billboard frame with convincing depth.
commands.instruction: Build a realistic billboard/display and let the exact product or related visual element cross beyond its frame with correct occlusion, shadows, perspective and environmental interaction. Make it feel like a photographed real-world illusion.

commands.label: Anamorphic 3D Display
commands.desc: Forced-perspective display illusion from one intended viewpoint.
commands.instruction: Create an anamorphic DOOH-style static concept designed for one ideal viewing angle. Use forced perspective so product and scene appear to extend beyond the screen volume. Preserve product proportions and screen geometry.

commands.label: Fake OOH / FOOH
commands.desc: Impossible public installation blended into a real place.
commands.instruction: Create a photoreal fake-OOH concept where the exact product or brand-relevant element becomes an impossible public installation. Use real architecture, crowd/traffic scale, weather, reflections and camera perspective to sell the illusion.

commands.label: Building Facade Takeover
commands.desc: Building skin becomes a bold branded spatial idea.
commands.instruction: Turn a believable building facade into a product/brand-driven spatial takeover using wrapping, protrusion, cut-through, integrated objects or sculptural intervention. Keep the effect physically coherent and context-aware.

commands.label: Building Transformation
commands.desc: Architecture opens, folds, slides or transforms to reveal product.
commands.instruction: Create a believable architectural transformation where walls, panels, roof or facade open, fold, slide or separate to reveal the exact product or branded experience. Preserve structural logic and realistic contact/shadows.

commands.label: Giant Inflatable Takeover
commands.desc: Oversized soft-body brand object takes over a public space.
commands.instruction: Create a giant inflatable CGI activation derived from the product, logo or brand-relevant object. Use believable fabric/air pressure, seams, tethering, soft-body deformation and environment scale; keep the actual supplied product accurate when shown.

commands.label: Cloth / Fabric Wrap
commands.desc: Large fabric or branded textile wraps architecture or landmark surfaces.
commands.instruction: Create a cloth-based CGI takeover where fabric wraps, drapes, unfurls or grips a facade/structure with believable folds, tension, gravity and wind. Use brand cues without implying a real partnership or installation unless supplied.

commands.label: Storefront Takeover
commands.desc: Shop window or storefront turns into a surreal 3D campaign.
commands.instruction: Transform a believable storefront or shop window into a bold CGI campaign using product scale, depth, window breakouts or spatial merchandising. Keep brand/product accuracy and realistic street reflections/contact.

commands.label: Mall / Atrium Activation
commands.desc: Large indoor mall space becomes an immersive brand installation.
commands.instruction: Create a mall/atrium CGI activation with believable retail architecture, escalators, balconies, shoppers and display scale. Make the exact product central to an experiential spatial idea rather than a plain screen.

commands.label: Airport Takeover
commands.desc: Airport architecture, baggage or travel systems become the campaign idea.
commands.instruction: Create a premium airport CGI takeover using terminal architecture, baggage belts, gates, jet bridges, luggage systems or aircraft-adjacent space as the visual mechanism. Do not imply airline or airport partnership unless supplied.

commands.label: Metro / Station Takeover
commands.desc: Station, platform or transit architecture becomes the campaign canvas.
commands.instruction: Create a transit CGI takeover using a metro station, platform, bus shelter or transport corridor. Integrate the exact product spatially without implying an official partnership unless supplied.

commands.label: Product × Train
commands.desc: Product interacts with train cars, tracks or railway infrastructure.
commands.instruction: Create a static FOOH-style campaign where the exact product rides, wraps, pulls, interrupts or spatially interacts with a train or railway system. Keep rail geometry, perspective and scale believable and do not imply transit sponsorship unless supplied.

commands.label: Vehicle Carry / Transport
commands.desc: Truck, bus, car or transport vehicle carries an oversized product.
commands.instruction: Create a believable campaign where a truck, bus, car or other vehicle transports, supports or interacts with an oversized exact product. Use realistic suspension, weight, contact and road scale.

commands.label: Claw / Crane Reveal
commands.desc: Mechanical claw or crane lifts, drops or reveals a giant product.
commands.instruction: Use a believable crane, claw-machine mechanism or lifting rig to hold, lower, retrieve or reveal the exact product at exaggerated scale. Show convincing cables, hooks, tension, contact and industrial physics.

commands.label: Conveyor / Delivery System
commands.desc: Product travels through an imaginative logistics or delivery mechanism.
commands.instruction: Create a static CGI campaign where the exact product moves through a conveyor, luggage belt, package sorter, chute, rail or branded delivery system. Use the mechanism as a visual story without inventing operational claims.

commands.label: Giant Gift Box Reveal
commands.desc: Oversized branded box opens to reveal product or experience.
commands.instruction: Create a giant gift-box or package reveal integrated into architecture or public space. The opening mechanism, paper/box structure, shadows and scale must feel believable; reveal the exact product without changing its packaging.

commands.label: Giant Vending Machine
commands.desc: Public-space vending mechanism turns product launch into an event.
commands.instruction: Create an oversized or surreal vending-machine CGI concept where the exact product is selected, dispensed or revealed. Use believable slots, doors, tracks, gravity and human scale; do not invent prices or offers.

commands.label: Portal Exit
commands.desc: Product or brand elements emerge from a dimensional portal in real space.
commands.instruction: Create a photoreal public-space portal through which the exact product or brand-relevant elements emerge. Use correct portal edge lighting, occlusion, depth and environmental interaction so it feels composited into the real scene.

commands.label: Rooftop Installation
commands.desc: Oversized product or brand sculpture dominates a believable rooftop.
commands.instruction: Place a monumental exact product or brand-relevant sculpture on or around a rooftop with realistic support, wind exposure, city scale, structural contact and shadows. Avoid unsupported floating.

commands.label: Landmark Takeover
commands.desc: Product interacts with a recognizable landmark or public structure.
commands.instruction: Create a respectful CGI interaction between the exact product and a landmark explicitly supplied or appropriate to the current location brief. Match lighting, perspective and scale and do not imply official endorsement or permission.

commands.label: Hot-Air Balloon Product
commands.desc: Product or branded form becomes a floating balloon spectacle.
commands.instruction: Create a hot-air-balloon style CGI concept derived from the product or brand shape, with believable envelope material, basket/tethers, altitude scale and atmospheric light. Preserve the exact product separately when it appears.

commands.label: Parachute Drop
commands.desc: Products descend into a city, event or landscape on parachutes.
commands.instruction: Create a static campaign capturing products or branded packages descending under believable parachutes. Use correct canopy inflation, cords, wind direction, scale and shadows. Keep product appearance exact.

commands.label: Blimp / Flying Product
commands.desc: Product becomes a giant airborne object above a real environment.
commands.instruction: Create a giant airborne product/blimp-style CGI spectacle with believable volume, altitude, atmospheric perspective and mooring/flight logic. Do not make it look like a tiny object pasted into the sky.

commands.label: Theme-Park / Ride Metaphor
commands.desc: Rollercoaster, ride or amusement system becomes a product-story device.
commands.instruction: Create a static CGI campaign using a rollercoaster, ride, track, ferris wheel or theme-park mechanism as a visual metaphor around the exact product. Make the interaction playful but physically coherent and brand-relevant.

commands.label: Glass World
commands.desc: Transparent glass structures create a premium spatial brand world.
commands.instruction: Build a brand-fit CGI world using clear, frosted or tinted glass with realistic refraction, caustics and reflections. Keep the supplied product materials unchanged unless explicitly requested.

commands.label: Chrome / Metal World
commands.desc: Reflective metallic forms create a sculptural commercial environment.
commands.instruction: Use chrome, brushed metal or polished reflective forms as supporting environment language. Control reflections and highlight gradients carefully; do not turn the exact product metallic unless requested.

commands.label: Fabric Sculpture World
commands.desc: Cloth folds, ribbons or soft surfaces become the main spatial device.
commands.instruction: Build a premium cloth/fabric environment with believable folds, tension, weight and material response around the exact product. Keep labels visible and avoid decorative cloth with no campaign function.

commands.label: Paper / Folded World
commands.desc: Folded paper, cards or packaging-like planes create depth and structure.
commands.instruction: Create a paper-engineered CGI world using folds, cut paper, cards, sheets or origami-like structural forms. Use brand colors and believable paper thickness/shadows; do not copy packaging dielines unless supplied.

commands.label: Clay / Foam World
commands.desc: Soft sculpted tactile forms create playful premium depth.
commands.instruction: Create a tactile clay, foam or soft-sculpted environment around the exact product. Use believable softness, dents, seams and lighting while preserving the product itself exactly.

commands.label: Liquid Interaction
commands.desc: Fluid becomes an active storytelling device rather than a generic splash.
commands.instruction: Use pours, ribbons, arcs, waves or controlled suspended droplets around the exact product with believable viscosity, contact and lighting. Choose liquid behavior that fits the current category and never imply unsupported ingredients.

commands.label: Giant Pour / Wave
commands.desc: A large liquid pour or wave becomes the central spatial campaign idea.
commands.instruction: Create a dramatic but physically coherent giant pour, wave or flow interacting with architecture, landscape or the exact product. Keep fluid scale, gravity, reflections and environmental contact believable and category-appropriate.

commands.label: Ice Encased
commands.desc: Product or environment is frozen inside realistic ice or frost.
commands.instruction: Create a campaign using realistic ice blocks, frost, trapped bubbles, condensation and controlled melt around the exact product. Never imply temperature resistance or performance unless supplied.

commands.label: Fire / Heat
commands.desc: Controlled flames, embers or heat become a cinematic campaign mechanism.
commands.instruction: Use believable flame, ember, glow and heat interaction around the exact product without damaging it unless explicitly requested. Never imply heat resistance or performance claims.

commands.label: Smoke / Cloud Sculpture
commands.desc: Smoke, vapor or cloud forms create depth and brand-shaped atmosphere.
commands.instruction: Use controlled smoke, vapor or cloud simulation as a sculptural visual device around the exact product. Keep opacity, scale, light scattering and product readability under control; do not imply ingredients or emissions.

commands.label: Particle / Swarm
commands.desc: Particles or repeated elements move as a designed field around product.
commands.instruction: Create a structured particle or swarm field using brand-relevant shapes, fragments or abstract elements. Use direction, density, scale and depth intentionally instead of generic dust.

commands.label: Falling / Scatter
commands.desc: Products or brand elements freeze mid-fall in a high-energy composition.
commands.instruction: Capture a physically believable frozen moment of falling, dropping or scattering exact products or brand elements. Use gravity, collision spacing, motion cues and shadows coherently without turning the image into clutter.

commands.label: Soft-Body / Inflatable
commands.desc: Puffy, inflated or soft-body forms create playful dimensional impact.
commands.instruction: Use soft-body or inflatable supporting forms with believable seams, pressure, deformation and contact. Preserve the real product geometry unless the brief explicitly asks for an inflatable product sculpture.

commands.label: Bubble / Transparent Orb
commands.desc: Transparent bubbles or orbs encapsulate and frame the product.
commands.instruction: Create a campaign using transparent bubbles, membranes or glass-like orbs with realistic refraction, surface tension and reflections. Keep the exact product undistorted and readable through the material.

commands.label: Hologram / Emissive
commands.desc: Controlled luminous forms and volumetric light create a digital spatial world.
commands.instruction: Use holographic, emissive or neon-like elements only when brand-appropriate. Build believable light spill, volumetric glow and reflections; avoid generic cyberpunk styling.

commands.label: Mirror / Reflection World
commands.desc: Mirrors and reflective planes multiply depth without clutter.
commands.instruction: Build a deliberate mirrored or reflective environment around the exact product using controlled reflections, symmetry/asymmetry and depth. Avoid impossible reflection errors and keep branding readable.

commands.label: Moss / Organic Takeover
commands.desc: Organic growth and vegetation partially reclaim the product world.
commands.instruction: Use moss, roots, vines, flowers or organic growth as a controlled takeover of supporting surfaces or architecture. Keep the exact product clean/readable unless the current brief explicitly requests organic coverage.

commands.label: Sand / Wind Simulation
commands.desc: Wind-driven sand or dust shapes the campaign environment.
commands.instruction: Use physically believable sand drift, dunes, suspended grains and wind direction around the exact product. Preserve product label visibility and avoid post-apocalyptic styling unless requested.

commands.label: Light Trail / Energy Path
commands.desc: Light paths guide the eye through a premium 3D composition.
commands.instruction: Create restrained luminous paths, beams or trails that connect space, product and focal points. Use the effect as compositional guidance, not as a factual energy/performance claim.

commands.label: Kinetic Sculpture
commands.desc: Mechanical or sculptural forms imply motion in one frozen campaign frame.
commands.instruction: Create a sophisticated kinetic-sculpture concept around the exact product using balanced moving arms, rings, tracks, suspended forms or mechanical choreography. Freeze the strongest readable moment with believable structure and support.

commands.label: Forest
commands.desc: Premium forest with layered natural depth.
commands.instruction: Integrate the exact product into a premium forest using trees, moss, roots, foliage, mist and shafts of light as appropriate. Keep contact and scale believable and make the forest support the brand idea rather than becoming generic green scenery.

commands.label: Jungle / Tropical
commands.desc: Dense tropical environment with humidity and layered vegetation.
commands.instruction: Use lush layered vegetation, large leaves, humid atmosphere, filtered light and water droplets where appropriate. Maintain strong product visibility and avoid covering important label areas.

commands.label: Modern City
commands.desc: Contemporary urban architecture and street-scale energy.
commands.instruction: Integrate the exact product into a believable modern city using architecture, plazas, traffic, sidewalks or rooftops. Choose urban styling that fits the brand rather than defaulting to Times Square.

commands.label: Street / Urban
commands.desc: Street-level campaign with authentic local urban detail.
commands.instruction: Use sidewalks, storefronts, walls, crosswalks, street furniture or alleys as brand-appropriate. Keep the result polished and intentional rather than defaulting to random graffiti.

commands.label: Country / Culture
commands.desc: Country or region-specific environment when explicitly supplied.
commands.instruction: Use the country/region explicitly named in the current request and build accurate high-level architecture, environment and cultural cues without stereotypes. If none is supplied, use a neutral globally readable setting rather than guessing.

commands.label: Rural / Village
commands.desc: Countryside or village world with grounded environmental detail.
commands.instruction: Use fields, village roads, farms, fences, carts, trees or local architecture where appropriate. Keep the exact product premium and readable while the setting feels believable and lived-in.

commands.label: Mountain
commands.desc: Epic high-altitude landscape with dramatic depth and scale.
commands.instruction: Use believable mountains, cliffs, valleys, trails, rock and atmospheric haze. Integrate the exact product through a campaign idea rather than simply placing it on a peak.

commands.label: Desert
commands.desc: Cinematic dunes, rock and heat atmosphere.
commands.instruction: Use wind-shaped sand, dunes, desert rock, long shadows or oasis cues only when relevant. Keep product materials accurate and avoid unnecessary post-apocalyptic styling.

commands.label: Snow / Ice
commands.desc: Winter environment with realistic frost and cold light.
commands.instruction: Use believable snow accumulation, ice, frost, winter atmosphere and cold light while keeping the product readable. Never imply temperature resistance or performance unless supplied.

commands.label: Beach / Coast
commands.desc: Bright coast, shoreline or boardwalk environment.
commands.instruction: Use sand, shoreline, cliffs, boardwalk or coastal architecture with believable sun, wind, reflections and contact. Avoid generic vacation-stock styling.

commands.label: Underwater
commands.desc: Submerged environment with convincing water optics.
commands.instruction: Use realistic caustics, refraction, bubbles, suspended particles and depth falloff while preserving label readability. Never imply waterproofing unless explicitly supplied.

commands.label: Space / Moon
commands.desc: Premium cosmic world with restrained sci-fi detail.
commands.instruction: Use lunar terrain, planetary scale, stars or orbital architecture only when useful. Keep product exact and avoid generic neon sci-fi clutter.

commands.label: Industrial / Factory
commands.desc: Engineered machinery and infrastructure world.
commands.instruction: Use machinery, pipes, production lines, engineered structures and metal surfaces as category-appropriate. Keep the environment premium and purposeful rather than dirty by default.

commands.label: Warehouse / Logistics
commands.desc: Large-scale warehouse, loading or logistics environment.
commands.instruction: Use racks, loading bays, conveyors, pallets, forklifts or large industrial interiors as spatial context. Keep brand/product central and do not imply logistics partnerships or capabilities unless supplied.

commands.label: Luxury Interior
commands.desc: High-end spatial design with refined materials.
commands.instruction: Use refined architecture, stone, wood, glass, metal, fabric and controlled lighting as brand-appropriate. Do not automatically make it black-and-gold.

commands.label: Gym / Fitness
commands.desc: Premium training environment with athletic energy.
commands.instruction: Use believable gym equipment, architecture and training atmosphere while keeping the exact product central. Do not invent strength, recovery or performance claims.

commands.label: Stadium / Sports
commands.desc: Large sports venue environment with dramatic scale.
commands.instruction: Use field/court, stands, tunnel, scoreboard or stadium architecture as environmental scale. Keep the exact product readable and never imply official sports sponsorship unless supplied.

commands.label: Café / Restaurant
commands.desc: Branded dining or beverage environment.
commands.instruction: Use counters, tables, kitchens, serving spaces, dishes or beverage-service architecture that fit the current category. Keep the scene premium and avoid inventing menu items or claims.

commands.label: Retail / Store
commands.desc: Modern store, shelf or experiential retail environment.
commands.instruction: Use believable shelves, counters, windows, merchandising, checkout or store architecture as a designed CGI world. Avoid a plain ecommerce shelf and do not invent pricing.

commands.label: Festival / Event
commands.desc: Large event, fair, expo or celebratory environment.
commands.instruction: Use stages, booths, installations, crowd space, banners, fairground structures or event architecture appropriate to the current brief. Do not invent dates, partnerships, sponsors or event names.
